about_the_game:
Cheater’s Table is a mafia-themed card game of deception and survival.
At this table, everyone cheats. Some hide cards, some bluff, some bait rivals. But in the end—someone always dies.

Sit across ruthless mafia bosses and play your way through a dangerous revenge story. Outsmart rivals in tense matches where lying is as important as the cards in your hand.

Features

  • Story Mode – Follow a noir revenge tale set in the criminal underworld.

  • Multiplayer PvP – Challenge friends or strangers in online matches where cheating is part of the rules.

  • Unique Cheat Mechanics – Hide joker cards, bait opponents, and call their bluffs.

  • Atmospheric Noir Visuals – Dark, cinematic environments that immerse you in the tension of the table.

  • Easy to Learn – Inspired by classic card games, but with a deadly twist.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of crime within a fictional mafia setting. It includes depictions of criminal behavior and mild language, but does not contain explicit sexual content, gore, or drug use. Players should be aware that the story involves cheating, intimidation, and high-stakes situations that may not be suitable for all audiences.

short_description: Simple rules, deadly consequences. A party card game where cheating is part of the rules. Experience a dark mafia revenge story, or challenge friends and family online in high-stakes PvP matches of bluffing, baiting, and survival.
